text.body: ॥ śrīśivasahasranāmastotram ॥ vande śaṃbhumumāpatiṃ suraguruṃ vande jagatkāraṇaṃ vande pannagabhūṣaṇaṃ mṛgadharaṃ vande paśūnāṃ patim । vande sūryaśaśāṅkavahninayanaṃ vande mukundapriyaṃ vande bhaktajanāśrayaṃ ca varadaṃ vande śivaṃ śaṅkaram vāsudevaḥ tatassa prayato bhūtvā mama tāta yudhiṣṭhira । prāñjaliḥ prāha viprarṣināmasaṃgrahamāditaḥ ॥ 1 upamanyuḥ brahmaproktairṛṣiproktairvedavedāṅgasaṃbhavaiḥ। sarvalokeṣu vikhyātaṃ stutyaṃ stoṣyāmi nāmabhiḥ॥ 2 mahadbhirvihitaissatyaissiddhaissarvārthasādhakaiḥ। ṛṣiṇā taṇḍinā bhaktyā kṛtairvedakṛtātmanā ॥ 3 yathoktaissādhubhiḥ khyātairmunibhistattvadarśibhiḥ । pravaraṃ prathama svargyaṃ sarvabhūtahitaṃ śubham ॥ 4 śrutaissarvatra jagati brahmalokāvatāritaiḥ। satyaistatparamaṃ brahma brahmaproktaissanātanam ॥5 vakṣye yadukulaśreṣṭha śṛṇuṣvāvahito mama । varayainaṃ bhavaṃ devaṃ bhaktasvaṃ parameśvaram ॥6 tena te śrāvayiṣyāmi yattadbrahma sanātanam । na śakyaṃ vistarātkṛtsnaṃ vaktuṃ śarvasya kenacit ॥ 7 yuktenāpi vibhūtīnāmapi varṣaśatairapi । yasyādimadhyamāntāni gamyante na surairapi ॥8 kastasya śaknuyādvaktuṃ guṇān kārtsnyena mādhava । kintu devasya mahatassaṅkṣiptārthapadākṣaram ॥9 śaktitaścaritaṃ vakṣye prasādāttasya dhīmataḥ। aprāpya tu tato'nujñāṃ na śakyaḥ stotumīśvaraḥ ॥10 yadā tenābhyanujñātasstuto vai sa tadā mayā । anādinidhanasyāhaṃ jagadyonermahātmanaḥ ॥11 nāmnāṃ kiñcitsamuddeśaṃ vakṣyāmyavyaktayoninaḥ । varadasya vareṇyasya viśvarūpasya dhīmataḥ ॥ 12 śṛṇu nāmnāṃ cayaṃ kṛṣṇa yaduktaṃ padmayoninā । daśanāmasahasrāṇi yānyāha prapitāmahaḥ ॥ 13 tāni nirmathya manasā dadhno ghṛtamivoddhṛtam । giressāraṃ yathā hema puṣpasāraṃ yathā madhu ॥ 14 ghṛtātsāraṃ yathā maṇḍaṃ tathaitassāramuddhṛtam । sarvapāpāpahamidaṃ caturvedasamanvitam ॥ 15 prayatnenādhigantavyaṃ dhārṃya ca prayatātmanā । māṅgalyaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva rakṣoghnaṃ pāvanaṃ mahat ॥ 16 idaṃ bhaktāya dātavyaṃ śraddhayā'nāstikāya ca । nāśraddadhānarūpāya nāstikāyājitātmane ॥17 yaścābhyasūyate devaṃ kāraṇātmānamīśvaram । sa kṛṣṇa narakaṃ yāti saha pūrvaissahātmajaḥ ॥ 18 idaṃ dhyānamidaṃ yogamidaṃ dhyeyamanuttamam । idaṃ japyamidaṃ jñānaṃ rahasyamidamuttamam ॥19 yaṃ jñātvā hyantakāle'pi gaccheta paramāṃ gatim । pavitraṃ maṅgalaṃ medhyaṃ kalyāṇamidamuttamam ॥20 idaṃ brahmā purā kṛtvā sarvalokapitāmahaḥ । sarvastavānāṃ rājatve divyānāṃ samakalpayat ॥ 21 tadāprabhṛti caivāyamīśvarasya mahātmanaḥ । stavarāja iti khyāto jagatyamarapūjitaḥ ॥ 22 brahmalokādayaṃ svarge stavarājo'vatāritaḥ। yatastaṇḍiḥ purā prāpa tena taṇḍikṛto'bhavat ॥23 svargāścaivātra bhūlokaṃ taṇḍinā hyavatāritaḥ । sarvamaṅgalamāṅgalyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ॥24 nigadiṣye mahābāho stavānāmuttamaṃ stavam । brahmaṇāmapi yadbrahma parāṇāmapi yatparam ॥25 tejasāmapi yattejastapasāmapi yattapaḥ । śāntānāmapi yaśśānto dyutīnāmapi yā dyutiḥ॥26 dāntānāmapi yo dānto dhīmatāmapi yā ca dhīḥ । devānāmapi yo deva ṛṣīṇāmapi yastvṛṣiḥ ॥ 27 yajñānāmapi yo yajñaśiśavānāmapi yaśśivaḥ । rudrāṇāmapi yo rudraḥ prabhā prabhavatāmapi ॥28 yogināmapi yo yogī kāraṇānāṃ ca kāraṇam । yato lokāssambhavanti na bhavanti yataḥ punaḥ।। 29 sarvabhūtātmabhūtasya harasyāmitatejasaḥ । aṣṭottarasahasraṃ tu nāmnāṃ sarvasya me śṛṇu ॥30 yacchrutvā manujavyāghra sarvān kāmānavāpsyasi । sthiraḥ sthāṇuḥ prabhurbhīmaḥ pravaro varado varaḥ ॥ 31 sarvātmā sarvavikhyātaḥ sarvassarvakaro bhavaḥ । jaṭī carmī śikhaṇḍī ca sarvāṅgassarvabhāvanaḥ ॥ 32 haraśca hariṇākṣaśva sarvabhūtaharaḥ prabhuḥ। pravṛttiśca nivṛttiśca niyataśśāśvato dhruvaḥ ॥33 śmaśānavāsī bhagavān khacaro gocaro'rdanaḥ । abhivādyo mahākarmā tapasvī bhūtabhāvanaḥ ॥34 unmattaveṣaḥ pracchannassarvalokaprajāpatiḥ। mahārūpo mahākāyo vṛṣarūpo mahāyaśāḥ ॥35 mahātmā sarvabhūtātmā viśvarūpo mahāhanu । lokapālo'ntarhitātmā prasādo nīlalohitaḥ ॥36 pavitraṃ ca mahāṃścaiva niyamo niyamāśritaḥ। sarvakarmā svayaṃbhūta ādirādikaro nidhiḥ ॥37 sahasrākṣo viśālākṣassomo nakṣatrasādhakaḥ । candrassūryaśśaniḥ keturgraho grahapatirvaraḥ ॥38 ādiranto layaḥ kartā mṛgabāṇārpaṇo'naghaḥ । mahātapā ghoratapā adīno dīnasādhakaḥ ॥ 39 saṃvatsarakaro mantraḥ pramāṇaṃ paramaṃ tapaḥ। yogī yojyo mahābījo mahāretā mahābalaḥ ॥ 40 suvarṇaretāssarvajñassubījo bījavāhanaḥ । daśabāhussvanimiṣo nīlakaṇṭha umāpatiḥ॥41 viśvarūpasvayaṃśreṣṭho balavīro balo gaṇaḥ । gaṇakartā gaṇapatirdigvāsāḥ kāma eva ca ॥ 42 mantravitparamo mantraḥ sarvabhāvakaro haraḥ। kamaṇḍaludharo dhanvī bāṇahastaḥ kapālavān ॥ 43 aśanī śataghnī khaḍgī paṭṭiśī cāyudhī mahān । suvahastassurūpaśca tejastejaskaro nidhiḥ ॥44 uṣṇīṣī va suvaktraśca udagro vinatastathā । dīrghaśca harikeśaśca sutīrthaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ca ॥45 sṛgālarūpaḥ siddhārtho muṇḍassarvaśubhaṅkaraḥ । ajaśca bahurūpaśca gaṅgādhārī kapardyapi ॥46 ūrdhvaretā ūrdhvaliṅga ūrdhvaśāyī nabhaḥ sthalaḥ । trijaṭaścīravāsāśca rudrassenāpatirvibhuḥ ॥47 naktañcaro'haścaraśca tigmamanyussuvarcasaḥ । gajahā daityahā kālo lokadhātā guṇākaraḥ॥ 48 siṃhaśārdūlarūpaśca vyāghracarmāmbarāvṛtaḥ । kālayogī mahānāthassarvakāmaścatuṣpathaḥ ॥49 niśācaraḥ pretarājo bhūtacārī maheśvaraḥ। bahubhūto bahudharaḥ svarbhānuramito gatiḥ ॥50 nṛtyapriyo nityanarto nartakassavalālasaḥ। mahāghoratapāśśūro nityo'nīho nirālayaḥ॥ 51 sahasrahasto vijayo vyavasāyo hyatandritaḥ । amarṣaṇo'marṣaṇātmā yajñahā kāmanāśakaḥ ॥ 52 dakṣayāgāpahārī ca susaho madhyamastathā । tejopahārī balahā mudito'rtho'jitā varaḥ ॥ 53 gambhīraghoṣo gambhīro gambhīrabalavāhanaḥ । nyagrodharūpo nyagrodhavṛkṣakarṇasthitirvibhuḥ ॥ 54 sutīkṣṇadaśanaścaiva mahākāyo mahānanaḥ । viṣvakseno hariyajñassaṃyugāpīḍavāhanaḥ ॥55 tīkṣṇatāpaśca haryaśvassahāyaḥ karmakālavit । viṣṇuprasādito yajñassamudro baḍabāmukhaḥ ॥56 hutāśanasahāyaśca praśāntātmā hutāśanaḥ । ugratejā mahātejā janyo vijayakālavit ॥57 jyotiṣāmayanaṃ siddhissarvavigraha eva ca । śikhī muṇḍī jaṭī jvālī mūrtijo mūrdhago balī ॥58 vaiṣṇavaḥ prajavī tālī khelī kālakaṭaṅkaṭaḥ। nakṣatravigrahamatirguṇabuddhirlayo'gamaḥ || 59 prajāpatirviśvabāhurvibhāgaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ। vimocanassumaraṇo hiraṇyakavacodbhavaḥ ॥60 meghajo balacārīca mahīcārī stutastathā । sarvatūryavinodī ca sarvavādyaparigrahaḥ ॥ 61 vyālarūpo guhāvāsī grahamālī taraṅgavit । tridaśaḥ kāladṛkkarmasarvabandhavimocanaḥ ॥ 62 bandhanastvasurendrāṇāṃ yudhi śatruvināśanaḥ। sāṃkhyaprasādo durvāsāssarvasādhuniṣevitaḥ ॥63 praskandano vibhāgajño hyatulyo yajñabhāgavit । sarvavāsassarvacārī durvāsā vāsavo'maraḥ ॥ 64 haimo hemakaro yajñassarvadhārī dharottamaḥ । lohitākṣo mahākṣaśva vijayākṣo viśāradaḥ ।। 65 saṃgraho nigrahaḥ kartā sarpacīranivāsanaḥ । mukhyo'mukhyaśca dehaśca kāhalissarvakāmadaḥ ॥ 66 sarvakālaprasādaśca subalo balarūpabhṛt । sarvakāmapradaścaiva sarvadassarvatomukhaḥ ॥67 ākāśanirvirūpaśca nipāto hyavaśaḥ khagaḥ । raudrarūpoṃ'śurādityo bahuraśmissuvarcasī ॥ 68 vasuvego mahāvego manovego niśācaraḥ। sarvavāsī śriyāvāsī upadeśakaro'karaḥ ॥ 69 munirātmā nirālokassambhagnaśca sahasradaḥ । pakṣī ca plakṣarūpaśca atidīpto viśāṃ patiḥ॥70 unmādo madanaḥ kāmo hyaśvattho'rthakaro yaśaḥ। vāmadevaśca vāmaśca prāgdakṣiṇa udaṅmukhaḥ ॥71 siddhayogī maharṣiśca siddhārthassiddhasādhakaḥ। bhikṣuśca bhikṣurūpaśca vipago mṛduravyayaḥ ॥72 mahāseno viśākhaśca ṣaṣṭibhāgo gavāṃ patiḥ । vajrahastaśva viṣkambhī camūstambhana eva ca ॥73 vṛttavṛttakarastālo madhurmadhukalocanaḥ । vācaspatyo vājasano nityamāśritapūjitaḥ ॥74 brahmacārī lokacārī sarvacārī vicāravit । īśāna īśvaraḥ kālo niśācārī pinākabhṛt ॥ 75 nimittastho nimittaṃ ca nandirnandikaro hariḥ। nandīśvaraśca nandī ca nandano nandivardhanaḥ ॥ 76 bhagahārī nihantā ca kālo brahmā pitāmahaḥ । caturmukho mahāliṅgaścāruliṅgastathaiva ca ॥77 liṅgādhyakṣassurādhyakṣo yogādhyakṣo rugāvahaḥ । bījādhyakṣo bījakartā adhyātmānugato balaḥ ॥78 itihāsassakalpaśca gautamo'tha niśākaraḥ । danbho hyadambho vaidambho vaśyo vaśakaraḥ kaliḥ॥79 lokakartā paśupatirmahākartā hyanauṣadhaḥ । akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma balavān śakta eva ca ॥80 nītirhyanītiśśuddhāmā śuddho mānyo gatāgataḥ । bahuprasādassusvapno darpaṇo'tha tvamitrajit ॥81 vedakāro mantrakāro viddhānsamaramardanaḥ। mahāmeghanivāsī ca mahāghoro vaśīkaraḥ ॥ 82 agnijvālo mahājvālo hyatidhūmro huto haviḥ । vṛṣabhaśśaṅkaro nityaṃ varcasvī dhūmaketanaḥ ॥ 83 nīlastathāṅgalubdhaśca śobhano niravagrahaḥ। svastidassvastibhāgaśca bhāgī bhāgakaro laghuḥ॥ 84 utsaṅgaśca mahāṅgaśca mahāgarbhaparāyaṇaḥ । kṛṣṇavarṇassuvarṇaśca indriyaṃ sarvadehinām ॥85 mahāpādo mahāhasto mahākāyo mahāyaśāḥ । mahāmūrdhī mahāmātro mahānetrī niśālayaḥ ॥86 mahāntako mahākarṇo mahoṣṭhaśca mahāhanuḥ । mahānāso mahākamburmahāgrīvaśśmaśānabhāk ॥87 mahāvakṣā mahorasko hyantarātmā mṛgālayaḥ । lambano lambitoṣṭhaśca mahāmāyaḥ payonidhiḥ॥ 88 mahādanto mahādaṃṣṭro mahājihvo mahāmukhaḥ । mahānakho mahāromā mahākeśo mahājaṭaḥ ॥89 prasannaśca prasādaśca pratyayo girisādhanaḥ । snehano'snehanaścaiva ajitaśca mahāmuniḥ ॥ 90 vṛkṣākāro vṛkṣaketuranalo vāyuvāhanaḥ । gaṇḍalī merudhāmā ca devādhipatireva ca ॥91 atharvaśīrṣassāmāsya ṛksahasrāmitekṣaṇaḥ । yajuḥpādabhujo guhyaḥ prakāśo jaṅgamastathā ॥ 92 amoghārthaḥ prasādaśca abhigamyassudarśanaḥ । upakāraḥ priyassarvaḥ kanakaḥ kāñcanacchaviḥ ॥ 93 nābhirnandikaro bhāvaḥ puṣkarasthapatiḥ sthiraḥ । dvādaśastrāsanaścādyo yajño yajñasamāhitaḥ ॥94 naktaṃ kaliśca kālaśca makaraḥ kālapūjitaḥ। sagaṇo gaṇakāraśca bhūtavāhanasārathiḥ ॥ 95 bhasmāśayo bhasmagoptā bhasmabhūtastarurgaṇaḥ । lokapālastathā loko mahātmā sarvapūjitaḥ ॥ 96 śuklastriśuklasampannaśśucirbhūtaniṣevitaḥ । āśramasthaḥ kriyāvastho viśvakarmamatirvaraḥ ॥97 viśālaśākhastāmroṣṭhohyambujālassuniścalaḥ । kapilā kapiśaśśukla āyuścaiva paro'paraḥ ॥98 gandharvo hyaditistārkṣyassuvijñeyassuśāradaḥ । paraśvadhāyudho devo hyanukārī subāndhavaḥ ॥99 tumbavīṇo mahākrodho ūrdhvaretā jaleśayaḥ। ugro vaśaṅkaro vaṃśo vaṃśanādo hyaninditaḥ ॥ 100 sarvāṅgarūpo māyāvī suhṛdo hyanilo'nalaḥ । bandhano bandhakartā ca subandhanavimocanaḥ ॥ 101 sa yajñārissa kāmārirmahādaṃṣṭro mahāyudhaḥ । bahudhā'ninditassarvaśśaṅkaraścandraśekharaḥ ॥102 amareśo mahādevo viśvadevassurārihā । ahirbudhnyo'nilābhaśca cekitāno haristathā ॥103 ajaikapācca kāpālī triśaṅkurajitaśiśavaḥ । dhanvantarirdhūmaketusskando vaiśravaṇastathā ॥104 dhātā śakraśca viṣṇuśca mitrastvaṣṭā dhruvo dharaḥ । prabhāvassarvago vāyuraryamā savitā raviḥ ॥ 105 uṣaṅguśca vidhātā ca māndhātā bhūtabhāvanaḥ । vibhurvarṇavibhāvī ca sarvakāmaguṇāvahaḥ ॥ 106 padmanābho mahāgarbhaścandravaktro'nilo'nalaḥ। balavāṃścopaśāntaśca purāṇaḥ puṇyacañcurī ॥ 107 kurukartā kuruvāsī kurubhūto guṇauṣadhaḥ । sarvāśayo darbhacārī sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ patiḥ ॥ 108 devadevassukhāsaktassadasatsarvaratnavit । kailāsagirivāsī ca himavadbhirisaṃśrayaḥ ॥109 kūlahārī kūlakartā bahuvidyo bahudaḥ। vaṇijo vardhakī vṛkṣo vakulaścandanacchadaḥ ॥ 110 sāragrīco mahājatruralolaśca mahauṣadhaḥ । siddhārthakārī siddhārthaśchandovyākaraṇottaraḥ ॥ 111 siṃhanādassiṃhadaṃṣṭrassiṃhagassiṃhavāhanaḥ । prabhāvātmā jagatkālaḥ kālo lokahitastaraḥ॥112 sārāṅgo navacakrāṅgaḥ ketumālī sabhāvanaḥ । bhūtālayo bhūtapatirahorātramaninditaḥ ॥113 vardhitassarvabhūtānāṃ nilayaśca vibhurbhavaḥ । amoghassaṃyato hyaśvo bhojanaḥ prāṇadhāraṇaḥ ॥114 dhṛtimān matimān dakṣaḥ satkṛtaśca yugādhipaḥ । gopālī gopatirgrāmo gocarmavasano hariḥ ॥ 115 hiraṇyabāhuśca tathā guhāpālaḥ praveśakaḥ । prakṛṣṭārirmahāharṣo jitakāmo jitendriyaḥ ॥ 116 gāndhāraśca suvāsaśca tapassakto ratirnaraḥ । mahāgīto mahānṛtyo hypsarogaṇasevitaḥ ॥ 117 mahāketurmahādhāturnaikasānucaraścalaḥ । āvedanīya āveśaḥ sarvagandhasukhāvahaḥ ॥ 118 toraṇastāraṇo vātaḥ paridhīpatikhecaraḥ। saṃyogo vardhano vṛddho hyativṛddho guṇādhikaḥ ॥119 nitya ātmā sahāyaśca devāsurapatiḥ patiḥ । yuktaśca yuktabāhuśca devo divi suparvaṇaḥ ॥120 āṣāḍhaśca suṣāḍhaśca dhruvo'tha hariṇo haraḥ। vapurāvartamānebhyo vasuśreṣṭho mahāpathaḥ ॥121 śirohārī vimarśaśca sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ। akṣaśca rathayogī ca sarvayogī mahābalaḥ ॥ 122 samāmnāyo'samāmnāyastīrthadevo mahārathaḥ। nirjīvo jīvano mantraśśubhākṣo bahukarkaśaḥ ॥123 ratnaprabhūto raktāṅgo mahārṇavanipānavit । mūlaṃ viśālo hyamṛto vyaktāvyaktastaponidhiḥ ॥124 ārohaṇo'dhirohaśva śīladhārī mahāyaśāḥ। senākalpe mahākalpe yogo yogakaro hariḥ ॥ 125 yugarūpo mahārūpo mahānāgahano vadhaḥ । nyāyanirvapaṇaḥ pādaḥ paṇḍito hyacalopamaḥ ॥126 bahumālo mahāmālaśśaśī harisulocanaḥ । vistāro lavaṇaḥ kūpastriyugaḥ saphalodayaḥ ।। 127 trilocano viṣaṇṇāṅgo maṇividdhau jaṭādharaḥ । bindurvisargassumukhaḥ śarassarvāyudhassahaḥ ।। 128 nivedanassukhājātaḥ sugandhāro mahādhanuḥ । gandhapālī ca bhagavānutthānassarvakarmaṇām ॥ 129 manthāno bahulo vāyuḥ sakalassarvalocanaḥ । talastāla karasthālī ūrdhvasaṃhanano mahān ॥ 130 chatraṃ suchatro vikhyāto lokassarvāśrayaḥ kramaḥ । muṇḍo virūpo vikṛto daṇḍī kuṇḍī vikurvaṇaḥ ॥131 haryakṣaḥ kakubho vajrī śatajihvassahasrapāt । sahasramūrdhā devendrassarvadevamayo guruḥ ॥132 sahasrabāhussarvāṅgaḥ śaraṇyassarvalokakṛt । pavitraṃ trikakunmantraḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ ॥133 brahmadaṇḍavinirmātā śataghnīpāśaśaktimān । padmagarbho mahāgarbho brahmagarbho jalodbhavaḥ ॥ 134 gabhastirbrahmakṛdbrahma brahmavidbrāhmaṇo gatiḥ। anantarūpaścaikātmā tigmatejāssvayambhuvaḥ ॥ 135 ūrdhvagātmā paśupatirvātaraṃhā manojavaḥ । candanī padmanālāgrassurabhyuttaraṇo naraḥ ॥136 karṇikāramahāsragvī nīlamauliḥ pinākabhṛt । umāpatirumākānto jāhnavībhṛdumādhavaḥ ॥137 varo varāho varado vareṇyassumahāsvanaḥ । mahāprasādo damanaḥ śatruhā śvetapiṅgalaḥ ॥138 prītātmā paramātmā ca prayatātmā pradhānadhṛt । sarvapārśvasukhastryakṣo dharmasādhāraṇo varaḥ॥139 carācarātmā sūkṣmātmā amṛto govṛṣeśvaraḥ । sādhyarṣirvasurādityo vivasvān savitā'mṛtaḥ ॥140 vyāsassargassusaṅkṣepo vistaraḥ paryayo naraḥ । ṛtussaṃvatsaro māsaḥ pakṣassaṃkhyāsamāpanaḥ ॥141 kalā kāṣṭhā lavā mātrā muhūrtāhaḥkṣapākṣaṇāḥ । viśvakṣetraṃ prajābīja liṅgamādyassunirgamaḥ ॥142 sadasadvyaktamavyaktaṃ pitā mātā pitāmahaḥ । svargadvāraṃ prajādvāraṃ mokṣadvāraṃ triviṣṭapam ॥143 nirvāṇaṃ hlādanaścaiva brahmalokaḥ parā gatiḥ । devāsuravinirmātā devāsuraparāyaṇaḥ ॥144 devāsuragururdevo devāsuranamaskṛtaḥ । devāsuramahāmātro devāsuragaṇāśrayaḥ ॥145 devāsuragaṇādhyakṣo devāsuragaṇāgraṇīḥ । devādidevo devarṣirdevāsuravarapradaḥ ॥146 devāsureśvaro viśvo devāsuramaheśvaraḥ । sarvadevamayo'cintyo devatātmātmasambhavaḥ ॥ 147 ūdbhittrivikramo vaidyo virajo nīrajo'maraḥ । īḍyo hastīśvaro vyāghro devasiṃho nararṣabhaḥ॥148 vibudho'gravarassūkṣmassarvadevastapomayaḥ । suyuktaśśobhano vajrī prāsānāṃ prabhavo'vyayaḥ ॥149 guhaḥ kānto nijassargaḥ pavitraṃ sarvapāvanaḥ । śṛṅgī śṛṅgapriyo babhrū rājarājo nirāmayaḥ ॥ 150 abhirāmassuragaṇo virāmassarvasādhanaḥ । lalāṭākṣo viśvadevo hariṇo brahmavarcasaḥ ॥ 111 sthāvarāṇāṃ patiścaiva niyamendriyavardhanaḥ । siddhārthassiddhabhūtārtho'cintyassatyavrataśśuciḥ॥152 vratadhipaḥ paraṃ brahma bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ । vimukto muktatejāśca śrīmān śrīvardhano jagat ॥153 yathāpradhānaṃ bhagavāniti bhakttyā stuto mayā । yaṃ na brahmādayo devā vidustatvena narṣayaḥ॥ 154 stotavyamarcyaṃ vandyaṃ ca kaḥ stoṣyati jagatpatim । bhakttyā tvevaṃ puraskṛtya mayā yajñapatirvibhuḥ ॥155 tato'bhyanujñā samprāpya stuto matimatāṃ varaḥ। śivamebhiḥ stuvan devaṃ nāmabhiḥ puṣṭivardhanaiḥ ॥156 nityayuktaśśucirbhūtaḥ prāpnotyātmānamātmanā । etaddhi paramaṃ brahma paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ॥157 ṛṣayaścaiva devāśca stuvantyetena tatparāḥ । stūyamāno mahādevastuṣyate niyatātmabhiḥ ॥ 158 bhaktānukampī bhagavānātmasaṃsthākaro vibhuḥ। tathaiva ca manuṣyeṣu ye manuṣyāḥ pradhānataḥ ॥ 159 āstikāśśraddadhānāśca bahubhirjanmabhisstavaiḥ। bhaktyā hyananyamīśānaṃ paraṃ devaṃ sanātanam ॥ 160 karmaṇā manasā vācā bhāvenāmitatejasaḥ । śayānā jāgramāṇāśca vrajannupaviśaṃstathā ॥161 unmiṣannimiṣaṃścaiva cintayantaḥ punaḥ punaḥ । śṛṇvantaśśrāvayantaśca kathayantaśca te bhavam ॥ 162 stuvantasstūyamānāśca tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca । janmakoṭisahasreṣu nānāsaṃsārayoniṣu ॥ 163 jantorvigatapāpasya bhave bhaktiḥ prajāyate । utpannā ca bhave bhaktirananyā sarvabhāvataḥ ॥ 164 bhāvinaḥ kāraṇaṃ cāsya sarvamuktasya sarvadā । etaddeveṣu duṣpāpaṃ manuṣyeṣu na labhyate ॥165 nirvighnā nirmalā rudre bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī। tasyaiva ca prasādena bhaktirutpadyate nṛṇām ॥ 166 yena yānti parāṃ siddhiṃ tadbhāvagatacetasaḥ । yaṃ sarvabhāvānugatāḥ prapadyante maheśvaram ॥167 prapannavatsalo devasaṃsārāttān samuddharet । evamanye na kurvanti devāssaṃsāramocanam ॥ 168 manuṣyāṇāmṛte devaṃ nānyā śaktistapobalam । iti tenendrakalpena bhagavān sadasatpatiḥ ॥ 169 kṛttivāsāsstutaḥ kṛṣṇa taṇḍinā śubhabuddhinā। stavametaṃ bhagavato brahmā svayamadhārayat ॥170 gīyate ca sa budhyeta brahmaśaṅkarasannidhau । idaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ ca sarvadā pāpanāśanam ॥ 171 yogadaṃ mokṣadaṃ caiva svargadaṃ toṣadaṃ tathā । evametatpaṭhante ya ekabhaktyā tu śaṅkaram ॥ 172 yā gatissāṃkhyayogānāṃ vrajante tāṃ gatiṃ tathā । stavamenaṃ prayatnena sadā rudrasya sannidhau ॥173 abdamekaṃ caredbhaktaḥ prāpnuyādīpsitaṃ phalam । etadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ brahmaṇo hṛdi saṃsthitam ॥174 brahmā provāca śakrāya śakraḥ provāca mṛtyave। mṛtyuḥ provāca rudrebhyo rudrebhyastaṇḍimāgamat॥175 mahatā tapasā prāptaṃ taṇḍinā brahmasadmani । taṇḍiḥ provāca śukrāya gautamāya ca bhārgavaḥ॥176 vaivasvatāya manave gautamaḥ prāha mādhava । nārāyaṇāya sādhyāya manuriṣṭāya dhīmate ॥ 177 yamāya prāha bhagavān sādhyo nārāyaṇo'cyutaḥ। nāciketāya bhagavānāha vaivasvato yamaḥ॥ 178 mārkaṇḍeyāya vārṣṇeya nāciketo'bhyabhāṣata । mārkaṇḍeyānmayā prāpto niyamena janārdana ॥179 tavāpyahamamitranaghna stavaṃ dadyāṃ hyaviśrutam । svaryamārogyamāyuṣyaṃ dhanyaṃ vedena sammitam ॥ 180 nāsya vighnaṃ vikurvanti dānavā yakṣarākṣasāḥ । piśācā yātudhānā vā guhyakā bhujagā api ॥ yaḥ paṭheta śuciḥ pārtha brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ। abhagnayogo varṣaṃ tu so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ॥ 182 iti śrīmanmahābhārate ānuśāsanikaparvaṇi dānadharmaparvaṇi śrīśivasahasranāmastotraratnakathanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ śrīśivasahasranāmastotraratnaṃ samāptam ॥
